services.name: Park Bench Program
services.desc: The Town of Collierville offers a meaningful way to honor and remember individuals who have made a positive impact on our community through the Commemorative Park Bench Program. This program allows residents, families, and organizations to sponsor a park bench within Town parks and public spaces. Each sponsored bench includes a personalized plaque that serves as a tribute while enhancing the character and accessibility of Collierville’s parks, trails, and green spaces. Applications are administered by the Parks Maintenance Division of the Public Works Department, in coordination with the Parks Department.
